decision_id: I4 Legal source-owned producer/consumer profile bridge
kind: author engineering decision packet for independent G review; no formal closure or external authority claim
status: narrow implementation authored; awaiting independent source review, freeze, and bounded actual serving proof
original_route_claim: A local controlled Legal generation from the ordinary CLI is consumable by a separate Runtime API process under the same source-owned runtime material profile; GET carries immutable generation intent; matching POST may use vector retrieval; stale/missing/wrong profile fails closed with typed refusal.

observed_gap.p40_bucket: same runtime-material owner/entrypoint handshake class, one level deeper
observed_gap.evidence: Ordinary `python -m polisyos.data_forge.domains.legal.batch embed-local` emitted complete entity/fact/provision generations from the actual cached pinned model, but generator_rule_version used an absolute model snapshot path and omitted `legal.runtime_material.v2=`. A fresh default Runtime API app returned GET available with immutable generation intent, then typed POST refusal `query_encoder_assets_unavailable`; default app has no source owner/provider. Separate C12 owner/provider witness independently has a true fresh API vector positive, but only through direct injection.

pattern_pass.anti_pattern: Owner appears only in injected witness/test wiring. Ordinary CLI emits no owner-bound basis; default app has no provider. Treating GET available as encoder readiness is a proxy. Uvicorn entrypoint can change sys.path, which is a full-profile input.
pattern_pass.target: One explicit local operator profile locator shared by producer CLI and module server; existing source-owned Legal owner verifies pinned cache/manifest; existing immutable GET intent and reader gate remain the query admission bridge; preserve complete runtime fingerprint.
pattern_pass.acceptance: With one selected profile root, actual ordinary producer emits owner-bound generations; separate fresh supported API process GET exposes selected intent, POST intent serialized from that GET returns vector fact-1. Stale intent, wrong profile and removed owner typed-refuse. Default no-provider app typed-refuses. No production currentness or legal truth inferred.

alternatives.name: Reuse existing owner and add explicit profiled entrypoints (chosen)
alternatives.impact: Small extension of existing LegalRuntimeMaterialOwner, builder keyword, LegalQueryEncoderProvider, RuntimeContainerOverrides and create_runtime_api_app. No generic configuration subsystem, new model or generation schema.
alternatives.migration: No profile specified keeps backward-compatible unowned candidate generation; default API keeps typed vector refusal. Explicit profile specified but malformed/missing files raises typed LegalRuntimeMaterialError and never falls back. Conflicting settings refuse. Operators that require vector search provide same profile root to producer/server.
alternatives.authority_time_status: Profile is local operator configuration and candidate runtime material only; not an HTTP field; confers no legal or production authority/currentness.

alternatives.name: Normalize/remove sys.path from runtime fingerprint
alternatives.impact: Changes a load-bearing runtime identity and risks concealing module shadowing; rejected. `python -m uvicorn`/console changed sys.path; raw module-invoked programmatic callable factory matched it, but only sys.path was tested.
alternatives.migration: Requires a separate G contract choice, new falsifier and invalidates prior receipts; out of scope.

alternatives.name: Leave owner composition test-only
alternatives.impact: Default app correctly refuses vector but ordinary CLI→server remains bridge_missing.

source_contract.profile_locator: Existing named C12 local controlled profile root `docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/LOCAL/raw/c12-real-encoder-profile`, containing fixed `hf-cache/` and `asset-file-manifest.txt` SHA-256 `191a71ec41bc1a69665fffccb5fa7f1c30b3f94ccd60f71cc3ed1f074ecb98ca`. The root is a locator only; source-owned owner revalidates actual bytes against fixed digest and manifest members.
source_contract.runtime_material_identity: Preserve source-pinned model/revision, package version, CPU/query/producer settings, source closure, assets, handle binding and exact full runtime profile including sys.path. No filename/self-label trust, fingerprint normalization, manifest rewrite, DTO/API change, or production currentness inference.
source_contract.profile_selection: Operator passes explicit `--runtime-material-profile-root PATH` to producer and module server. Not HTTP request input. Fixed relative child names are `hf-cache` and `asset-file-manifest.txt`.
source_contract.entrypoint: `python -m polisyos.runtime.http.profiled_server --runtime-material-profile-root PATH` composes owner→LegalQueryEncoderProvider→RuntimeContainerOverrides→create_runtime_api_app→Uvicorn callable factory. Module invocation preserves observed sys.path; no console entrypoint, `app_dir`, or sys.path change.

delivery_sequence: Decision packet was written before implementation; the root coordinator owns ordinary Git delivery and history boundaries.
TDD observed the intended red: the owner profile-root factory was absent and the producer CLI rejected the explicit profile option.
Implemented the fixed-child owner profile-root factory and optional embed-local profile wiring; no-profile defaults remain delegated to the existing builder and invalid explicit roots refuse.
Implemented the module-invoked profiled server using the existing provider/container/app APIs; the default app path has no injected profile.

Focused unit and existing importer tests pass (26 total, including a None-row refusal regression); the opt-in integration remains skipped by default and now persists full producer/server/HTTP/wrong-profile outputs to the assigned receipt directory. Canonical Ruff, formatting, and diff checks pass. The repository-configured targeted basedpyright command with the existing C12 rag-local interpreter reports 0 errors and 3 warnings (missing SentenceTransformer stubs and an existing protected _owns access); the checked baseline hash remained unchanged.
Await independent delta review and freeze source/input/profile.

After freeze/review, run one bounded actual one-row cached-model CLI→separate actual HTTP server wave; retain full output, GET intent, matched vector POST fact-1, stale/wrong-profile/owner-removal controls, and exact profile inputs. Other 13-supplier C12 wave remains separate.

limits.current_sys_path_prototype: Only sys.path equality was tested for programmatic module Uvicorn; not full warmed profile or Legal owner HTTP route.

falsifier: If same-profile owner-bound ordinary generation and fresh server still refuse after GET exposes its exact persisted intent, investigate the owner/profile bridge. If stale intent, wrong profile, or removed owner still returns vector-positive, implementation fails.
